title: Find the safe step and measure the slow valley
brief: Read the curvatures of a bowl, predict the shrink factor on each axis, pick the best step along a line, then measure the condition number, the shrink ratio of a walk, and the steps to reach a tolerance.
hints: np.linalg.eigvalsh(A) returns the eigenvalues of a symmetric matrix in ascending order, so the first is mu and the last is L.
axis_factors is np.abs(1 - step * eigenvalues). At step 0.3 on the bowl with curvatures 1 and 10 it is [0.7, 2.0].
exact_line_search_step is (g @ g) / (g @ A @ g). On the running bowl at (0, 0) it is 101 / 1001.
condition_number is L / mu, and eigenvalue_range(A) already returns (mu, L).
contraction_ratios: errors = np.linalg.norm(path - w_star, axis=1), then errors[1:] / errors[:-1].
steps_to_tolerance: np.nonzero(errors < tol * errors[0])[0]. Return the first index, or -1 when the array is empty.
